title: Kinetic Word-Pop Hook
description: Words pop and scale in one at a time, center-anchored with subtle motion blur. Creates immediate subconscious readability without visual clutter.
rebuildFormula: Scale 0.8 -> 1.05 -> 1.0 (overshoot easing cubic-out) + opacity 0 -> 1. Stagger 110ms per word. Font: Inter or SF Pro Display Bold.

title: iOS-Style Timer Card (Proof Object)
description: Pill-shaped glassmorphic card with circular countdown dial in pure white. Pairs spoken claims ("in under 5 minutes") with an objective visual twin.
rebuildFormula: Rounded pill rect (radius 24px) + background blur(12px). Circular SVG ring with stroke-dashoffset transition over spoken duration.
codeSnippet: 04:59 REMAINING

title: Fake Player Mockup (Context Frame)
description: Simplified dark 16:9 mockup player floating over clean background with a single high-contrast accent progress bar. Eliminates browser chrome distractions.
rebuildFormula: 16:9 container with 16px corner radius, drop shadow 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4). Progress line animated from 0% to 35% with linear ease.

title: High-Impact Price/Stat Stamp
description: Huge bold stat or price ($456,000) that slams onto screen with slight screen-shake and bass-drop audio sync.
rebuildFormula: Scale from 2.0 -> 1.0 in 150ms with camera shake (translate ±4px for 3 frames). Impact sound effect at frame 4.

title: Topographic Vector Path Sweep
description: Glowing vector stroke that draws itself along geographical borders or line charts while camera executes a smooth 3D parallax tilt.
rebuildFormula: SVG path with stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset: pathLength -> 0. Blend mode: screen or add over vintage paper texture.
codeSnippet:
<svg className="w-full h-32">
  <path d="M10,80 Q95,10 180,60 T350,30" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" strokeWidth="3"
    className="animate-[dash_3s_ease-in-out_forwards]" strokeDasharray="500" strokeDashoffset="0" />
</svg>

title: Paper Texture Whip Transition
description: Analog ripped paper edge wiping across the screen at 1/12s with synchronized tearing Foley.
rebuildFormula: Horizontal translate -100% -> 100% in 180ms with 3-frame stop motion jitter (step-end easing).

title: Social Proof / Mockup Gag Card
description: Floating social feed or UI mockup card with spring entrance that visually proves or satirizes the spoken claim.
rebuildFormula: Rounded 20px glass card (rgba(15,23,42,0.92)) + spring y:-24->0 in 380ms (back.out(1.8)).

title: Screen Highlight & Terminal Callout Box
description: macOS-inspired dark workspace window with traffic light dots and syntax-highlighted command lines.
rebuildFormula: Dark slate window (#0d1117) with 1.5px cyan border glow and monospace command output.

title: Chapter Act Title Banner (Top Safe Area)
description: Top-anchored frosted glassmorphic act banner with chapter pill tag and bold uppercase headline.
rebuildFormula: Top 6-8% safe area placement, backdrop-filter blur(24px), y:-26->0 entrance with back.out(1.8).

title: Neon Tool & Capability Badge
description: Vibrant icon + category tag + bold title card highlighting a specific software tool, AI model, or concept.

title: 3D Metaphor Floating Concept Card
description: 2.5D layered visual card with subtle parallax drift and depth shadow illustrating an abstract concept.
rebuildFormula: Scale 1.0->1.14 with x/y camera drift (+24px, -14px) using sine.inOut easing.

title: Breathe Loop Ambient PiP Frame
description: Picture-in-Picture speaker bubble in bottom-right corner with rounded 28px border and glowing rim over full-screen visual.
rebuildFormula: Speaker video scales to 0.36 at bottom-right with 28px radius while background layer scales 1.0->1.12.

title: Split Comparison Metric Pill
description: High-contrast gold/emerald stat callout comparing before vs after or highlighting a key percentage.
rebuildFormula: Gold border glow (#ffd60a) + 58px extra-bold stat typography.

title: Minimalist Lower-Third Identity Pill
description: Clean left-accented glassmorphic lower-third introducing speaker or core thesis without blocking face.
rebuildFormula: 4px solid accent bar + slide-in from left (-20px -> 0) in 350ms.

title: Hook Quotient & Viral Takeaway Stamp
description: Immediate high-retention opening hook stamp paired with fast camera push-in to lock first-3-second viewer retention.
